=== 1 claim(s) BLOCKED (failed attempt, no current analysis) ===

=== BLOCKED: C-1 (status=OPEN, attempts=1) ===
claim: 

Before re-dispatching OR concluding NEGATIVE, answer three questions
(reason from THIS specific failure - do not pick from a fixed menu):

  1. method_assumption   - what did the failed method assume would happen?
  2. assumption_validity - is that assumption justified given the evidence?
                           if NOT justified -> the METHOD failed, not the behavior absent
  3. next_method         - what DIFFERENT method tests a different assumption?
                           (literal retry is forbidden; 'method was adequate' only if Q2=justified)

Record with:
  python scripts/failure_analysis_gate.py <ws> C-1 --record \
      --assumption "..." --validity not-justified|justified-adequate --next-method "..."

See failure-modes reference (recall #268): failure-modes.md, failure-modes-lifecycle.md, failure-modes-monitoring.md, failure-modes-state.md, case-book.md, convergence-loop.md
